name: TDEnemy
src_typeComment: Drop on any enemy prefab alongside WaypointPatrol (set its Mode to Once) and a Health component — this bridges both to Tower Defense state: reaching the end of the path damages the base, dying to tower fire grants currency. Also needs a Collider (any type) for TDTower's OverlapSphere targeting to find it.

src_serialized.name: damageToBase
src_serialized.tooltip: Damage dealt to the base's Health when this enemy reaches the end of its path.

src_serialized.name: rewardCurrency
src_serialized.tooltip: Currency granted when this enemy is killed before reaching the base.

src_serialized.name: rewardAmount
src_serialized.tooltip: How much of rewardCurrency is granted.

src_members.sig: public Health Health => health != null ? health : (health = GetComponent<Health>())
src_members.name: Health
src_members.comment: Exposed so attack behaviours (TDHitscanAttack, TDProjectile) can reuse this cached reference instead of each doing their own GetComponent<Health>() on every hit.
